from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, sys
runtime=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge'
sys.path.insert(0,str(runtime))
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('installed_bridge_route_resilience',runtime/'bridge_server.py')
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
assert getattr(mod.Handler,'server_version','')=='PredictionChatWake/1.2-chat-scoped-route'
task='BRIDGE-MANUAL-PIN-CHECK-20260930-E004'
binding=mod.base.route_binding_for_task(task)
assert binding is not None, 'E004 route missing'
assert binding.get('chat_id')=='chat-c-1f222c10-10', binding
assert binding.get('consumer_id') is None, binding
base_source=(runtime/'bridge_server_v2.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert '# INFLIGHT_RUNTIME_V1' in base_source, 'inflight runtime patch lost'
locations=[]
for name in ('outbox','inflight','sent'):
    d=runtime/name
    if d.exists():
        for p in d.glob('*.json'):
            try:
                text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
            except Exception:
                continue
            if task in text:
                locations.append(f'{name}/{p.name}')
assert locations, 'E004 result evidence missing'
print('ROUTE_CONSUMER_RESILIENCE=PASS')
print('HANDLER_VERSION='+mod.Handler.server_version)
print('E004_CHAT='+binding['chat_id'])
print('E004_CONSUMER_SCOPE=CHAT')
print('INFLIGHT_PATCH=PRESERVED')
print('E004_LOCATIONS='+','.join(locations))
